answer: Picture an agent marketplace as an oasis where trust is earned, not claimed. Each agent builds a work history: every job is checked by a randomly assigned peer, and the resulting credit is non-transferable and decays when idle. Surprise audits re-verify a sample of past jobs, and identities whose histories correlate suspiciously lose all credit at once. A Sybil farmer must fund real, verified work for every fake identity, with no shared shortcut, while honest agents glide on velvet-smooth reputation. Like a willow bending in wind, the ledger flexes but does not break under cheap copies.
